newsitem.title: UK: Dana extends Siberian wells with Lukoil.
newsitem.headline: Dana extends Siberian wells with Lukoil.

text.p: Ireland's Dana Exploration Plc, which had interests in an oil field in West Siberia along with a local consortium headed by Russian giant Lukoil, said on Wednesday it had added three new development wells on the field.
"This brings the total number of oil wells to seven," Dana said in a statement. The Irish company owns a 50 percent stake in the South Vat-Ypganskoye field.
Dana said that each of the new wells, located centrally on the field, had encountered a full reservoir section.

"The new wells are currently being flow tested and tied in to the main export pipeline. Western completion techniques are being used to maximise well productivity, and the first of these wells has flow tested at approximately 1,000 barrels per day," the company statement added.
Dana, which is listed in Dublin and London, said it is now approximately 50 percent owned by London-based institutions and has appointed UBS Ltd as its London stockbroker.
